 国际学生移动支付及银行汇款指南
 International Student Guide to Mobile Payments & Bank Transfers
 一、学费 Tuition
 1. 本科生项目 Undergraduate Programs:
 1.1 中文授课：人民币29,000元/学年
 Chinese-taught: RMB 29,000/year
 1.2 MBBS英文授课：人民币75,000元/学年
 MBBS, English-taught: RMB 75,000/year
 2. 硕士研究生项目：人民币37,000元/学年
 Master’s Program: RMB 37,000/Year
 3. 博士研究生项目：人民币45,500元/学年
 Doctoral Program: RMB 45,500/Year
 二、报名费 Application Fee
 人民币800元 RMB 800
 三、支付方式 Payment Methods
 1. 仅限人民币支付
 RMB (CNY) payments only
 2. 报名费：移动支付（支付宝/微信）或银行汇款
 Application Fee: Mobile Payment (Alipay/WeChat Pay) or Bank Transfer
 3. 学费：银行汇款
 Tuition: Bank Transfer
 四、银行汇款相关信息 Bank Transfer Information
 1. 银行账户：1001253709026403462
 2. 账户名：上海交通大学医学院
 3. 收款银行名称及地址：工商银行上海市瑞金二路支行
 4. 转换码：ICBKCNBJSHI
 5. 汇款币种：人民币
 6. 附言：ISO+申请人护照姓名，例：ISO + PETER LEE
 1. Bank Account Number: 1001253709026403462
 2. Account Name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine
 3. Beneficiary Bank Name & Address: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Shanghai Branch, Rui Jin Er Road Sub-Branch
 4. SWIFT Code: ICBKCNBJSHI
 5. Currency: Renminbi (CNY/RMB)
 6. Remittance Remarks/Message to Beneficiary: ISO + Applicant’s Passport Name (e.g., ISO + PETER LEE)
 五、移动支付（支付宝/微信）流程
 Mobile Payment (Alipay/WeChat Pay) Process
 1.在上海交通大学医学院国际学生入学申请系统（http://applyiso.shsmu.edu.cn）上提交申请后，进入“支付报名费”环节（见下图）。
 After submitting your application on the Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine International Student Application System (http://applyiso.shsmu.edu.cn), proceed to the “Pay Application Fee” step (see screenshot below).
 2.在“方式一：在线支付（仅支持支付宝/微信支付）”下方，点击“立即在线支付”，进入校园支付平台页面（见下图）。
 Under “Option 1: Online Payment (Alipay/WeChat Pay Only)”, click "Proceed to Online Payment” to enter the campus payment platform page (see screenshot below).
 3.在校园支付平台页面选择支付方式，通过微信或支付宝支付人民币800元（见下图）。
 On the campus payment platform page, select your payment method and pay RMB 800 via WeChat Pay or Alipay (see screenshot below).
 地址：上海市半夏路1号东2楼 
 电话：0086-21-63847078 
 邮箱：liuxue@shsmu.edu.cn
